name: ruff
description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter with 800+ built-in rules

ruff.description: Lightning-fast Python linter with comprehensive rule coverage and auto-fixing
ruff.usage:
ruff check . # Lint current directory with default rules
ruff check --fix . # Auto-fix violations where possible
ruff check --select E,F --ignore E501 src/ # Select specific error codes, ignore line length
ruff format . # Format Python code with Black-compatible styling
ruff format --check --diff src/ # Check formatting without writing, show differences
ruff check --output-format=json . # Output violations as JSON for tooling integration
ruff rule E501 # Explain specific rule (line-too-long)
ruff linter # List all supported upstream linters (flake8, pylint, etc.)
ruff check --select ALL --ignore ANN,D . # Enable all rules except type annotations and docstrings
ruff server # Start language server for IDE integration
